embed.title: !stop
embed.description: Pause all your alerts without losing your tracking.

fields.name: Usage
fields.value:
`{{prefix}}stop` — stop all alerts. Your tracking, areas and profiles are kept.
`{{prefix}}start` — resume them.

`{{prefix}}stop` takes nothing after it: `{{prefix}}stop pokemon` is refused, and nothing is stopped.

fields.name: Stopping only some alerts
fields.value:
`{{prefix}}untrack` — remove tracking rules (`{{prefix}}help untrack`)
`{{prefix}}mute` — silence a pokemon, gym, area and so on for a while (`{{prefix}}help mute`)

fields.name: {{#if userIsAdmin}}Admins{{/if}}
fields.value: {{#if userIsAdmin}}`{{prefix}}stop user:<id>` — pause another user. In a registered channel, `{{prefix}}stop` pauses the channel.{{/if}}

fields.name: Related
fields.value: `{{prefix}}unregister` — delete your account and all tracking for good
